title: Stream
description: A stream that extracts from a source, maps fields, and upserts into an Emporix target type.

sourceEntity.description: The logical source entity or record.

targetWriter.description: The target writer code, for example `emporix.customEntity`.

targetType.description: The default target type (custom-entity type identifier).

mode.description: How the stream contributes to the target.

deltaField.description: The source field whose value is tracked as the delta watermark. A delta run extracts only the records whose value is newer than the last run's.

deltaFieldFormat.description: How the delta field's values are formatted, so they can be compared correctly.

compositeParent.description: For a composite child stream, the name of the stream it contributes to.

linkingField.description: For a composite child stream, the source field holding its parent's key.

embedAttribute.description: For a composite child stream, the parent attribute its records are embedded into.

childStrategy.description: How a composite child's records reach the parent object.

writeStrategy.description: How an existing target object is updated. `PATCH` changes only the mapped fields and preserves everything else; `REPLACE_PUT` replaces the whole object, so fields this import does not manage are cleared.

discriminatorField.description: A source field whose value routes each record to a different target type, as defined by `discriminatorMap`.

discriminatorMap.description: Maps a discriminator value to the target type that receives those records.

deleteConfig.description:
How deletes are detected in the source and propagated to the target. Omit for an upsert-only
stream. `MARKER`: a field on the record flags it as deleted. `TOMBSTONE`: a separate source
record lists the deleted IDs.

mode.description: How a deleted record is recognised.

markerField.description: `MARKER` only. The source field that flags a record as deleted.

markerValues.description: `MARKER` only. The values of `markerField` that mean deleted.

record.description:
`TOMBSTONE` only. The explicit name of the source record that lists deleted IDs. Omit this
property when the name can be derived from the imported record by adding a prefix or suffix —
for example, `invoice_deleted` for an `invoice` stream. Specify it when the deletion record
does not follow that naming convention.

HealthThresholds.title: Health thresholds
HealthThresholds.description: The limits that decide whether a stream is reported as `GREEN`, `AMBER`, or `RED`. Each field is optional and resolves independently. An unset field falls back through the hierarchy, from the most specific level to the least specific: stream, configuration, tenant, then the built-in default.

failureRatioAmber.description: The share of failed records (0..1) at or above which the stream is `AMBER`.

failureRatioRed.description: The share of failed records (0..1) at or above which the stream is `RED`.

staleAmberHours.description: The age threshold, in hours, for the stream's newest data. The stream is `AMBER` when the data's age reaches or exceeds this threshold.

staleRedHours.description: The age threshold, in hours, for the stream's newest data. The stream is `RED` when the data's age reaches or exceeds this threshold.

failedRunIsRed.description: Whether a failed most-recent run makes the stream `RED` regardless of the other limits.
